description:
Introducing the good ol' MARIGOLD 0% Fat Yoghurt Drink but now in an ALL NEW Pink Guava flavour; made with real fruit juice!

Did you know? A poor diet or stress may cause the good bacteria in our gut to diminish, resulting in an imbalance.

Filled with the goodness of Probiotic Cultures and blended with real fruit juice, MARIGOLD 0% Fat Yoghurt Drink helps promote a healthy digestive system and as a result, a healthy immune system! Here’s to the pink of health!
